name: DurableJobRecovery

startup_recovery.precondition: new host already owns canonical data instance exclusively; recovery finishes before READY and before ordinary claims are enabled
steps: first enumerate every nonterminal queued/running/waiting_review/retry_wait job with dedupe_sha256=NULL in deterministic job_id order; these are legacy pre-migration-8 jobs whose semantic dedupe identity cannot be proven
for each legacy-NULL row use its own short BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction and revalidate state plus dedupe_sha256 IS NULL before mutation
for a legacy-NULL running row with valid claimed_run_id/claim_started_at_utc/attempt_count, insert exactly one job_attempts outcome=interrupted for that ordinal when it is not already represented

set every legacy-NULL nonterminal row to failed, clear claimed_run_id/claim_started_at_utc/next_attempt_at_utc, preserve bounded payload/checkpoint as historical technical evidence, and set last_error_code=LEGACY_JOB_DEDUPE_UNAVAILABLE; never derive/backfill a semantic key from historical payload
then find remaining state=running jobs whose claimed_run_id differs from current run in deterministic job_id order
for each stale row use its own short BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction and revalidate the exact stale claim tuple before mutation
validate exact job contract/version; unknown contract fails safe and never executes
insert job_attempts outcome=interrupted using stored claim_started_at_utc, stale claimed_run_id and attempt_count ordinal only when that ordinal has not already been represented
apply exact registered job-type crash recovery policy: queued, retry_wait, failed, or waiting_review
clear stale claim fields and persist bounded stable technical error/disposition
never resume arbitrary in-memory code position; restart only from durable checkpoint/contract
startup_recovery.concurrency: revalidation under each writer transaction makes both legacy reconciliation and stale-claim recovery idempotent; a row already reconciled/recovered or otherwise changed is skipped/handled from current persisted state rather than receiving duplicate attempt history
startup_recovery.readiness_rule: any unreconciled legacy-NULL nonterminal row, recovery integrity failure or recovery transaction failure blocks READY and ordinary claims until a later startup recovery pass succeeds

restore_reconciliation.precondition: a cryptographically and structurally verified historical database has replaced the live database, host remains QUIESCING, restored DB is open through the verified LLD-12 SQLCipher provider, and no coordinator claims are permitted yet
restore_reconciliation.transaction: one LLD-01 recovery-finalization UnitOfWork before runtime may become READY
steps: enumerate all restored durable_jobs in deterministic job_id order whose state is queued, running, waiting_review, or retry_wait

for a restored running row with a valid prior claimed_run_id/claim_started_at_utc, insert exactly one job_attempts row outcome=interrupted using that prior run identity and attempt_count ordinal if that ordinal is not already represented

set every restored nonterminal durable_jobs row to cancelled, clear claimed_run_id/claim_started_at_utc/next_attempt_at_utc, set last_error_code=RESTORE_SNAPSHOT_JOB_INVALIDATED, and preserve bounded payload/checkpoint/dedupe identity only as historical technical evidence
leave completed, failed, and already-cancelled rows unchanged
commit this reconciliation in the same recovery-finalization boundary that records required restore receipt/audit evidence, before enabling ordinary job claims
rules: restoring a historical snapshot never silently replays queued/retry/waiting external work
no job-type opt-in restore-resume exists in Beta 1.0; an operator or owning-domain workflow must explicitly start genuinely desired new work after readiness
restored job cancellation is technical workflow reconciliation and does not reverse or fabricate owning-domain lifecycle state
unknown job type/version remains fail-closed and cannot become executable during restore

shared_rules: recovery never fabricates packet/domain lifecycle state
job_attempts uniqueness on job_id + ordinal is revalidated before inserting interrupted history
payload/checkpoint content is never used to reconstruct a missing migration-8 semantic dedupe identity
all error evidence is bounded stable technical code; raw exception, secret, provider content and unrestricted path data are forbidden
